en: A historic black and white photograph postcard depicting a large crowd gathered in front of an ornate building, likely during a public event or parade. The architecture features classical columns and statues. The crowd is dense, with many people wearing hats typical of the early 20th century. The printed text at the bottom provides context about the event, mentioning Strasbourg, General Gouraud, and the date November 22, 1918.
